question: Luv starts from Point A and drives 8 km towards the east. He then takes a right turn and drives 5 km, then turns right and drives 11 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 12 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 3 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and in which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90-degree turns only unless specified.)
solution:
Given: 

Luv starts from Point A and drives 8 km towards the east.

He then takes a right turn and drives 5 km, then turns right and drives 11 km.

He then takes a right turn and drives 12 km.

He takes a final right turn, drives 3 km and stops at Point P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/efdc48887abcb5b47db692686734e0c42f6365ce930f98160056d46e7234e1a2.png] 

So, He should drive **7 km to the south** in order to reach Point A again.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
